correctness.rationale: The exact face condition |F∩P_i|+|F∩{u,v}|≤2 gives A=join of 2-skeleta on each page (complexes of subsets of cardinality at most two), B=join of 1-skeleta. A has homology (exterior-square augmentation)^tensor-k in degree 2k−1 and B has augmentation^tensor-k in degree k−1; both are wedge-of-spheres complexes. For k≥2 B→A is null by connectivity. Adjoining two cone tips gives two suspensions of B; the additional shared-edge 1-cell gives S¹. Naturality of integral chain bases gives the Koszul-signed full automorphism modules; the core-swap reverses H1 and interchanges the two lower-degree summands. The source verifier built faces from the triangle rule, checked homology ranks in characteristics 2 and 3 for seven parameter cases, and checked 21 signed Lefschetz values; it produced ALL_VERIFY_OK cases=7 modular_betti=14 signed_lefschetz=21. The finite tests corroborate but do not replace the uniform proof.

value.rationale: The natural edge-clique sum is the first graph family violating the diamond-free hypothesis in the motivating shellability work. The theorem yields a persistent fundamental group Z and two distinct binomial sphere-multiplicity families, uniformly for all q≥4 and k≥2. It determines the full integral C2×(S_{q-2} wr S_k) homology modules rather than only Betti numbers, and supplies rational acyclicity of the full automorphism quotient; it differs substantively from vertex-glued clique books and tests the boundary of existing qualitative theories.
